name: Geometry Intelligence: Rub
description: Local AI assistant with a from-scratch experimental model and sourced Geometry Dash tools.

history.name: Save Chat History / Zapisuj historię
history.description: Encrypted local history. Off deletes the saved history on the next chat operation; in-memory context remains until exit or Clear Data.

endpoint.name: AI Engine URL / Adres silnika
endpoint.description: Our from-scratch Python server: http://127.0.0.1:18765/v1. Optional Ollama: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1. Chat Completions tool API required.

model.name: Model Selection / Nazwa modelu
model.description: gi-tiny is our own experimental model. Use Connection in the chat to list installed models. No paid API required.

streaming.name: Streaming / Odpowiedzi na żywo
streaming.description: True SSE from the model. Turn off if your optional provider does not support SSE.

music-search.name: Music Search / Muzyka
music-search.description: Free MusicBrainz metadata search; it is not a GD whitelist. Known Newgrounds Song IDs can be checked against GD. An optional Brave key enables Newgrounds discovery.

web-search.name: Internet Search / Wyszukiwanie WWW
web-search.description: Without a key: Wikipedia for web queries and MusicBrainz for music. Optional Brave key enables broader search. Public API consent is required.

public-consent.name: Allow Public APIs / Zezwól na publiczne API
public-consent.description: Sends query terms or IDs to Pointercrate, Geode, GD servers, MusicBrainz, Wikipedia and any configured search provider. It does not send whole chats to these tools.

remote-consent.name: Allow Remote AI / Zezwól na zewnętrzne AI
remote-consent.description: External models receive recent conversation, retrieved facts and any enabled game context. Requires HTTPS. Leave off for our local model. A localhost relay must also remain local.

game-context.name: Share Game Context / Udostępnij dane ekranu
game-context.description: Copies level name, creator, ID, song ID, stars and screen type. No account data, level strings, objects, saves or inputs. Never edits levels.
